name: Dranik’s Scar: South
summary: A war‑torn canyon front where Muramite forces push toward the Catacombs and Discord ruptures destabilize the land.
description: Scar South is the most violently contested section of Dranik’s Scar. Muramite assault forces use the southern canyon as their primary push toward the Dranik Catacombs. Discord ruptures tear through the stone, creating unstable terrain and arcane hazards. Dragorn resistance fighters maintain fallback trenches and barricades, but the area is under constant siege. The canyon floor is scarred by battle, collapsing stone, and the hum of Discord energy.
